title: Local-First Image Generation Bridge and Encrypted Retention Architecture
summary: KESPA established an operational local-first image-generation path that detects image requests in chat, routes them through an authenticated OpenAI-compatible image bridge to localhost-only ComfyUI on an RTX 3070, returns the generated image to the conversation, and retains it as an encrypted private artifact. The implementation also adds plan-aware generated-image retention, automated worker/application cleanup, and storage-provider routing for future S3-compatible backends; external image fallback, production object-storage configuration, higher-quality checkpoints, and formal image-quality benchmarking remain outside this verified checkpoint.
